title: BOOK-102 - Create Booking
description: Allows a guest to reserve a room at the hotel by selecting dates and entering personal information.
acceptance_criteria: Guest can select check-in and check-out dates.
Guest enters first name, last name, email, and phone.
Booking cannot overlap an existing reservation.
Booking is stored in the system.

test_cases.title: create a booking with valid details
preconditions: Guest is on the booking page
steps: Enter first name, last name, email, and phone.
test_cases.expected_result: Booking is confirmed and a confirmation message is displayed.

test_cases.title: attempt booking with overlapping reservation
preconditions: Existing reservation overlaps the selected dates
steps: Select check-in and check-out dates that overlap with an existing reservation.
Enter first name, last name, email, and phone.
test_cases.expected_result: Booking is not allowed and an error message is displayed.

test_cases.title: validate required fields during booking
preconditions: Guest is on the booking page
steps: Leave one or more required fields empty.
test_cases.expected_result: Booking is not submitted and validation messages are displayed for each empty required field.
